unreachable.reason: Schema-valid run events cannot carry work-unit or round identity; the corpus mutates an already validated event to exercise the independent reducer defence.
Schema-valid gate transitions require active-test fingerprint and paths together; the corpus mutates an already validated transition to exercise the independent reducer defence.
Schema-valid native decisions always carry both request and response bindings; the corpus mutates an already validated decision to exercise the independent reducer defence.
